notes.title: Erythristic Update is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/90350d27430e10fb1aa3b1dac574413c5566a972.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

Two new dinosaur skin types and a pair of lever-action rifles join the hunt. The trophy lodge now lets you display trophy shots, while new story notes deepen Tenebris lore. Fresh callers expand your hunting options - and the game is now fully Steam Deck Verified!

Thank you to our great community for your continued support! ːsteamhappyː

Check out the patch video for more details:
[previewyoutube=4ffVWGc5eMY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New dinosaur skin types[/h1]
The update includes a total of 42 new unique skins for the huntable species! These come with the introduction of 2 new skin types for all the species which means each species now has 7 skin variations. From most common to the rarest here is the up-to-date list of skin types:
[list]
[*]Common
[*]Rare
[*]Piebald
[*]Xanthochromistic
[*]Melanistic
[*]Albino
[*]Erythristic
[/list]

[h2]Xanthochromistic [/h2]
Xanthochromistic skins are exhibiting unusually high levels of yellow pigmentation, resulting in golden to yellowish tones that differ greatly from typical coloration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/bda251b64297df65904cc2b0e3b48646ea7f4fc4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/3e25b1b8910e2bb5058dc375843cd11c670002a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/090fc66d7b7736f9b4663e132d9904a0e9928b38.png[/img]

[h2]Erythristic[/h2]
Erythristic skins have overexpression of red pigments, producing vivid reddish, copper, or rust-colored appearances uncommon in the wild type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/ae42492fcead3eadbb77de6fbe3811dd8e300d39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/2479974f14ee19c5653237da0cca03a26a9d201a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/527da7453862472d0ad57446fb9f48cd08ccd887.png[/img]

[h2]How the new skins affect scoring? [/h2]
In scoring the rarity bonus is given in the following way depending on the skin type:
[list]
[*]Piebald : 20%
[*]Xanthochromistic : 40%
[*]Melanistic : 60%
[*]Albino : 80%
[*]Erythristic : 100%
[/list]

[h1]New weapons: lever-action rifles[/h1]
A new weapon type in the form of lever-action rifle is introduced. There are two rifles to choose from. Lever-action rifles are quick to handle and do decent damage but have slightly less penetration and range than bolt-action rifles. Scopes can be used on both rifles.

[h2]Greystone .45-70 Lever-Action Rifle[/h2]
This is a heavy rifle that is more suitable in taking down the bigger dinos. Magazine can fit 6 bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/d9901b8aa27f3a230f2b65a71a2e7ceebc0c30a3.png[/img]

[h2]Ashford .30-30 Lever-Action Rifle[/h2]
Ashford lever-action rifle is more suitable for smaller game and has a large magazine of 8 bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/2895035482bdeb6523d4528635b669dd68063b1d.png[/img]

[h1]Verified Steam Deck support[/h1]
Prehistoric Hunt has officially been tested and is now Steam Deck Verified!
This means full controller support, smooth performance, and a fully functional interface on the Deck.

[h1]Trophy lodge: Display trophy shots[/h1]
You can now display your trophy shots in the trophy lodge. Before you taxidermize your catch if you’ve taken a trophy shot with it you’ll be able to show it in the lodge stand. The trophy shots are displayed on rectangular and round stands on separate frames. You can customize the placing of the frame when interacting with the stand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/c732bfbb6922e9b662b01c51f35e24c778c97fd3.png[/img]

[h1]Buy dropped items back from the shop[/h1]
In the shop players can find a new menu where they are able to recover items dropped. The recover price is 25% of the purchase price. If you don’t want to walk back to your death location this makes the recovery a bit easier.

Please note the current functionality allows you to buy back the items from your latest death location. If you died multiple times without recovering the items in the middle the previous death locations will still have the boxes and you can recover them by travelling to the location. And the recovery isn’t possible in a different session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8bd642a7de00134425bfa5bfc8a0ab6ec355fcfc.png[/img]

[h1]New story notes for Tenebris[/h1]
Exploring Tenebris Island will now reveal additional lore notes scattered across the environment. These fragments expand the island’s backstory, uncovering more details about its past operations and secrets.

[h1]New callers[/h1]
New species introduced on the Tenebris island got their own callers: Sinornithosaurus, Parasaurolophus, Stegosaurus, Quetzalcoatlus and Therizinosaurus. The callers are available in the shop and you can find them in loot boxes if you’re lucky!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/374aa6d1a3a2b6c401f1806cf560f40f2ea16b31.png[/img]

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]When losing connection to server / suspending game recovering and rehosting
[*]Trophy camera rigidbody manipulation improved
[*]Improved cursor management in lodge when using controller
[*]Leaderboard tabs interactable with controller on first open
[*]Satellite phone can spawn in loot boxes
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed grass in trophy camera
[*]Fixed Tenebris island dock sink hole
[*]Fixed missing prompts in weekly challenge menu
[/list]

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts.

notes.title: Tenebris Update has landed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/90350d27430e10fb1aa3b1dac574413c5566a972.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

We are extremely happy to announce Tenebris update is here! The update brings a whole new map, 7 new dinosaur species and numerous other improvements to the game.

Thank you to our great community for your support and feedback throughout the journey! <3


[h1]New Map – Tenebris island[/h1]
The island features several unique and visually distinct special locations. Bringing the new island to life required major changes and optimizations. While most of these aren’t directly visible in gameplay, they lay the groundwork for better performance, stability, and future features. To give you an idea of the scale, the old map has objects in tens of thousands, but the new map has them in hundreds of thousands. The new island features a lot of new environment assets that are utilized to create distinct biomes on the island. There are new story notes one can discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/d984d4bab4dc56e0c40a1db0449d1891e7741d65.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/5e984f75c0edbc47dc062a397e9ff740bf94bf5f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/2377dc13a9726c260d496a4c548eab979adcd9be.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/50631c8ba99f0764f549f73bb047f325594c3e35.png[/img]

[h1]Environment & Asset Enhancements[/h1]
We have made significant improvements to foliage quality, asset LODs, and visual consistency across biomes. Distant environment now have increased visual quality. All vegetation assets have been uniformed and upgraded to the same shader, enabling better control in game systems like the weather system.

[h1]New dinosaur species[/h1]
The update adds 7 new dinosaur species who will be inhabiting the new map. 
[h2]Allosaurus[/h2]
Allosaurus makes its debut as a formidable new predator. Allosaurus is easily recognized from its large skull with ridged colorful crests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/9667a3c30ecd0abe1f584b2d8bd89edc64da41d2.png[/img]

[h2]Stegosaurus[/h2]
Stegosaurus is a slow-moving herbivore known for its distinctive row of large, upright plates along its back and a spiked tail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/ff1947ef5974ea9c957b94cf49da2a492742023d.png[/img]

[h2]Therizinosaurus[/h2]
Therizinosaurus is a unique-looking herbivore recognized by its towering claws - each over a meter long - used for defense and foraging. It stands upright with a long neck and feathered body, making it one of the most easily recognized and unusual dinosaurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/89ebf8ef806a653360dedc75cf970d80b87406d0.png[/img]

[h2]Sinornithosaurus[/h2]
Sinornithosaurus is a small, feathered dinosaur known for its bird-like appearance and agility. Recognized by its wing-like arms, sharp teeth, and long tail, it hunts in packs, can climb trees and glide from trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/92dc7c7323dad44f526790c272c41eaffc059c19.png[/img]

[h2]Sarcosuchus[/h2]
Sarcosuchus is a massive crocodyliform, easily recognized by its elongated snout and sheer size - reaching over 30 feet long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/879d1f66ec8107d48de8bc456fa0f59434849e61.png[/img]

[h2]Quetzalcoatlus[/h2]
Quetzalcoatlus is one of the largest flying animals in history, recognized by its impressive height, long neck, and enormous wingspan. It soars over vast distances in search of prey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/213a728edcbffc03b39d0020345eb7f1c7ba9713.png[/img]

[h2]Parasaurolophus[/h2]
Parasaurolophus is a herbivorous dinosaur known for the long, curved crest on its head. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8a3c8eca7998f245e940f460c33839e8fb2be9b3.png[/img]

[h1]Reworking existing species[/h1]
5 existing species got big improvements.
[h2]Tyrannosaurus Rex[/h2]
Tyrannosaurus Rex has an all-new model, animations and textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/0a3e3e25f011f3fe592a7a0d2c59fc602767b924.png[/img]

[h2]Spinosaurus[/h2]
Spinosaurus has got a new model and new textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/b932305c301ebfffe75ab872e74a94c9ae11a1b5.png[/img]

[h2]Brachiosaurus[/h2]
Brachiosaurus has got a new model and new textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/f905c6e83dad10981c5c7b89c88d3cc673313167.png[/img]

[h2]Pteranodon[/h2]
Pteranodon has new textures for all variants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8dff5123061c0105790ccd756979da792467285f.png[/img]

[h2]Carnotaurus[/h2]
Carnotaurus too has new textures for all variants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/c913c4a318fe8b97a891c7b5e36c552c58bedf9d.png[/img]

[h1]Dinosaur AI & animation upgrades[/h1]
Dinosaurs are receiving smarter AI: enhanced reactions to player actions, expressive head movements, improved herd and group behaviors, and natural-feeling movement.

We have been developing a more modular AI system which is for example used by Sinornithosaurus. This system will enable us to in the future make the flying species spend more time on the ground etc.
[h1]Audio overhaul[/h1]
The game’s audio has been reworked. Dinosaurs make more different types of calls, some more quiet and some louder. You’ll hear some familiar dinosaur sounds but also a lot of new sounds from the old species.

The ambience sounds have been renewed. You’ll hear more dynamic ambience elements in the environment getting a more lively feeling. 

The player sounds were renewed with focus on the footstep sounds.
[h1]Fast travel item: Satellite phone[/h1]
You’re now able to purchase a satellite phone with which you can call a helicopter to pick you up from anywhere in the map. A helicopter will lower a winch and if you interact with it, you’re able to fast travel to all special locations you’ve discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/efb2f11a2cb6480192b7dca85f2b254a664fdd2a.png[/img]

[h1]Old map (Moreau island) improvements[/h1]
Most trees on Moreau island were reworked. Many environment textures and models on the old map were improved too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/6e0058ed860f6e0ed25532435b43f750c0edd970.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/30143997d05c90f1bd2b65184cf9044c83bf1ccd.png[/img]

[h1]Performance optimization[/h1]
The update comes with extensive environment optimizations aimed at maintaining stability and high frame rates, even in more complex or crowded areas. 

[h1]Memory optimization[/h1]
Faster loading is achieved through better preprocessing and memory optimizations.

[h1]Game engine update[/h1]
Upgraded engine with support for advanced features like ray-tracing, smoother movement, and better cross-platform compatibility.

[h1]Gun feel & Player improvements[/h1]
The gun sway pattern has been reworked to give a more uniform way to handle the gun while aiming. Player character will now stick more to the ground when traversing over bumpy terrain. This makes player movement feel less floaty.

[h1]Player corpses added[/h1]
Player will create a corpse on death.

[h1]Map editor improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix dinosaur spawn limit in Mods
[*]Map editor selection arrows change color based on mode (move, rotate, scale)
[*]Selection does not go through the tool selection UI in Map editor
[*]UI elements take less unnecessary space

notes.title: Custom Maps Update has been published!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/90350d27430e10fb1aa3b1dac574413c5566a972.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

A fresh update is here! It includes custom maps with map editor, a composite bow, reworked dinosaur models among other improvements. Check out these patch notes to see all included content.

Watch the patch video here:
[previewyoutube=1H1mtJw_oXU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Custom maps & map editor[/h1]
Players can create custom maps and publish them for others to play through Steam Workshop. These maps can be played both in solo or in multiplayer. 
Custom maps have been in our public beta for over a month now and we did get a lot of feedback, thank you for that! Here are some screenshots of maps created by users GodEater and HeartOfTheWild (Thank you for your effort! ːsteamhappyː) that are available to play through Steam Workshop:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/0fadfc878c36e2f7b225427a244f4d21d986c16e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/4a8e8054a5b3e220ecf4ede558d3e3d377260653.png[/img]

To use the map editor have a look at these testing version instructions:
[previewyoutube=duY5MglOFRU;full][/previewyoutube]

Please note that these instructions don’t contain all the updates we have done during the testing phase. We will be releasing an up-to-date version of the instructions later. 

Here are some highlights what you can do with the editor:
[list]
[*]Choose map size from Medium (2x2km) and Large (4x4km). And you can choose to create an island or inland map
[*]Generate a base terrain according to set parameters to accelerate map creation
[*]Create roads
[*]Create areas and generate own textures and objects on them
[*]Create special locations
[*]Add custom objects
[*]Generate gameplay elements
[/list]

[h1]Hunting Bow[/h1]
A new composite hunting bow is now available. Compared to the old tribal bow it’s more deadly and easier to use over longer distances due to less arrow drop. It does cost a bit more though. It’s also very silent to use so you won’t spook your prey. With it comes new ammo type called Carbon Arrows that you will find in the shop or loot boxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/2d933ea8ea603718995e9454b195db3b10325679.png[/img]

[h1]Reworked Compsognathus[/h1]
The old Compsognathus model has been replaced with a totally new one with new textures and animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/cd3c8320edf9e81c0e1e05251087a95cc7222357.png[/img]

[h1]Reworked Pachycephalosaurus[/h1]
Pachycephalosaurus got a rework too: New model, animations and textures have been released in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/9211faeaa53cc8e17ff348dfb52364b94176ba55.png[/img]

[h1]Dinosaur AI improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]All dinosaurs will now spend more time still either idling, eating, drinking or sleeping depending on the species. 
[*]Larger carnivores hunt less herbivores.
[/list]

[h1]Dinosaur corpse markers[/h1]
Two new dinosaur carcass markers have been added to both the environment and the map view. Once you’re near a dinosaur carcass a dino skull icon will appear on top of a carcass. This will help you identify any corpses in dense environments and is helpful especially with smaller dinos. The icons are displayed until the dinosaur has been claimed.

In the map view you will see a red dot for a new dinosaur carcass. You will only see these markers for dinosaurs where you are the killer as indicated in the trophy screen. If you hover the red dot icon you’ll see what species it is. The icon is shown until the dinosaur has been claimed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/a57d72e8d5229b91a264926dbabe03a72d6693db.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/12b31e05d04a7f77df85a96e2b7b18dba98db608.png[/img]

[h1]Prioritized dinosaur interaction[/h1]
Dinosaur carcasses take priority over footprints and blood marks when using interact. This will be helpful especially with compies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/5b25a7b5e1da3ce0f241a952dfa3569bdd2381e4.png[/img]

[h1]First person secondary animations improvement[/h1]
Walk, crouch and other secondary animations have been improved. The character movement on different terrain feels smoother now. The animations better match footsteps. Sidesteps happen at the same speed as forward steps. This improvement also fixed the issue with swaying hands while playing with slower FPS.

[h1]Trophy lodge updates[/h1]
A new stand is available in trophy lodge: Small stand. You can use it to display Compsognathus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8126c8cdbe9c2206af41a712d3b7077e53f852a9.png[/img]

[h1]Dinosaur descriptions improvement[/h1]
All dinosaur description texts were improved by our community members BonzerK, God Eater, Megatron and Oblivion is at hand. Thank you for your help!

[h1]Reset key bindings in main menu[/h1]
You can now reset your key bindings to default by holding C and R buttons in main menu. A message will pop up when the reset has been done. This will help in situations where some mistaken key bindings would prevent the player from doing anything in the game. You no longer must go to Windows registry to reset settings.

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Heart and lung shots cause a lot longer bleeding. A heart shot will eventually be deadly for any dinosaur.
[*]Improved upper body animations in third person characters
[*]Improved performance of mangrove trees
[*]Optimized weekly walk server data. Past challenges now ordered from latest to oldest
[*]Weekly challenge list can be scrolled. 
[*]End time of past Weekly challenges is shown. 
[*]Weekly challenge reward can be obtained in Weekly Challenge menu too (no longer only in main menu). 
[*]Leaderboard entries are shown at top of scroll list even when low entry count.
[*].700 Double rifle iron sights were reworked.
[*].50 Cal rifle iron sights were improved.
[*]Updated French and German translations (Thank you MagSouille and NQ!)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/0fa31ca4b346ec671be6c0d8b1136d495b0029f9.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed rejoin functionality in multiplayer
[*]Client players see correct clothing on other players
[*]Fixed syncing of gloves for 3rd person characters
[*]Fixed issue where other players in multiplayer could have multiple guns on hand at once
[*]Fix for 50 cal reload animation where the right hand would bug out sometimes
[*]Holding breath no longer triggers while gun is recovering from fire. (No more slow-motion effect when recovering)
[*]Fix for holding breath causing weirdness in animation when stopping aiming or starting to reload.
[*]Fixed Brachiosaurus stomp sounds happening while standing still idling.
[*]Fixed translation errors with new translation validator.
[*]Fixed animation while using callers or binoculars while running.
[*]Fixed issue with camo net and hide functionality that caused player to be unable to change any equipment
[/list]

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts. What would you like to see next?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/b05e056829ffe27383ad125a764dd7e502fbd105.png[/img]

[h1]Things to take into account before starting testing[/h1]

The testing version of the game utilizes different server. You won’t be using the same player in the test version but start from zero with a fresh player (if you didn’t participate in development testing before). Once you move back to the main server you will continue progress with your existing account and lose any progress made in the test server.

[b]Before you start transferring your game into the open testing mode please make a backup of your player.txt file. It can be found in %steamlibrary_folder%/Prehistoric Hunt/Prehistoric_Hunt_Data/player.txt . The file contains your trophy lodge setup and it will be overwritten if you don’t take a backup. Once you move back from the test version to the actual game you can copy this backup file back to it’s original location.[/b]

Please note that when you have the test build active you cannot launch the actual game. When you want to switch back to it in the Betas-menu you will need to choose ‘None’ to get back. You can freely switch between the versions.

[h1]Instructions how to get the test version[/h1]

Right click the game name in Steam library list view and choose ‘Properties’. Then choose tab ‘Betas’. From the dropdown choose “public_test”. Steam will now download the test version and you’ll see in your library view instead of “Prehistoric Hunt” name “Prehistoric Hunt [public_test].

[h1]Testing the custom map editor[/h1]

Watch the video in the beginning of this post to learn the main features. 

Please note that some generation operations might freeze the game for a few seconds while they are running. It’s advisable to wait for them to complete without clicking anywhere.

You will find the custom map editor in the main menu by going to PLAY – MAP EDITOR. When starting your first map choose CREATE NEW MAP and when you come back to edit it choose EDIT MAP. 

Created maps are stored in %steamlibrary_folder%/Prehistoric Hunt/Prehistoric_Hunt_Data/maps/ with own folder for each map. [b]We recommend you to backup this folder regularly so you can revert unwanted changes! [/b]

We will summarize feedback on our Discord about the tool.

Thank you for your support! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Third Anniversary Update is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/19f066fe046bf8f94891dfb9d83a69d4610416dc.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

Time to celebrate our third anniversary with a fresh update! A few weeks late but it’s finally here! It features a new tutorial mode, reworked dinosaurs, weekly challenges and grass. Read on to find what’s included.

It’s been a great journey and we want to thank our great community for your support! ːsteamhappyː Your continued feedback and ideas help us keep going! We are looking forward to the next year with you!

Check out the patch video here:
[previewyoutube=N1dXAVxkldM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Tutorial mode[/h1]
New players start the game with new tutorial mode before being able to go to the actual game map. Tutorial is voice and text narrated and it goes through the basics of the game. Tutorial is played in a new map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/6c040c78742dfc4312c0d96c4e08ef427909be28.png[/img]

[h1]Gun range[/h1]
Players can now practice their shooting skills on a gun range (without the need to go to it through the tutorial). It is a separate map that’s completely safe and absent of any dinos. You can shoot with any weapons you currently own. Bullets are free at the gun range so you don’t use any of your own ammunition while in the gun range (infinite mark is shown in bullet amount). The gun range has five shooting places each with their own targets. The targets are at distances of 30m, 50m, 150m, 300m, 500m and 1000m. 

Gun range can be used in multiplayer too so you can have a shooting competition! In the top right corner you will see the last hit on a target along with total and average hit score. You can reset your score with the machine at the shooting place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/0289b8e622e2c19fe941e95d5757099c5ee3cdae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/cce335c4a6952017a64d05662f12b854014aa7e0.png[/img]

[h1]Weekly challenge[/h1]
We are introducing weekly challenges where players competed against each other in different kind of challenges. Normal and hard mode have their own weekly challenges. Top three players will be rewarded with gold, silver and bronze cups. These you can then put on display in your lodge. When you inspect the cup it’ll show you details of the challenge where you won it. Top 10 players also get coins and experience points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/12ca61cbeba456231aa2ea76cbe6caed109eff7e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/29c5bb60db21b6b0f42ca3699f1a5e0f9ec0fd9b.png[/img]

[h1]Grass rework[/h1]
The environment has completely new grass. The grass is overall lower and smaller and scattered more in the environment. There are multiple different types of grass. This also fixes the flashlight beam cut issue the older grass had. This grass also reacts to dinosaurs and players: It will bend when interacted with. New grass provides better visibility for players as it isn’t as tall as the old grass and will bend beneath player drastically improving visibility while crouched.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/e373215bbfbee00c1ecf56aa44ed490dc841bd3c.png[/img]

[h1]Utahraptor rework[/h1]
Utahraptor has been reworked with completely new model, animations and textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/3eb603bb59c5705a9621a4c4c4ce82216d4d8bfb.png[/img]

[h1]Gallimimus rework[/h1]
The old Gallimimus model has been replaced with a new model along with new animations and textures. They will now eat from bushes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/605cdfea43f4b5c3b711b3755bec3dbdab933a39.png[/img]

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated French translation (Thanks MagSouille!)
[*]Client player can see own arrows in dinosaurs.
[*]Multiplayer server list shows chosen map and difficulty.
[*]Added in game clock which is visible in menus.
[*]Optimized contract data storage on server.
[*]When selecting "use" on gun in inventory, the gun will be put in hand if it is put to the active equipment slot.
[*]Special location markers are now smaller further away.
[*]Improved basic rifle texture.
[*]Improved some furniture colliders in lodge.
[*]New footstep sounds for concrete.
[*]Better matched grass footstep sounds for different materials.
[*]New contracts for Pachycephalosaurus, Gallimimus, Utahraptor, Spinosaurus and Thalassodromeus.
[*]Full binomial names for all species have been added to stats info page.
[*]Improved culling: Less things disappear which are in view and more efficiency at hiding nonvisible things.
[*]Improved secondary first-person animations.
[*]Improved performance of large bushes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/0332077fbf298dcf8b874e7ead2a1e5edd02e1ea.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed dropped items no longer going through the ruins at Ruins special location.
[*]Fixed ruins stone material displacement issues
[*]Fixed dropped items being put inside rocks, etc. when standing on them.
[*]Improved handling of Steam authentication failure.
[*]Client players no longer have higher spread in shots than host.
[*]Fixed high contract submit count causing issues with not registering and not getting credits.
[*]Null error fixes in player, client player, spawn, player manager, spawncontroller, anim transitions and tracking data disposal.
[*]Fixed Scotch character’s nail material.
[*]Fixed small table lod in lodge.
[*]When dying or taking trophy shot with utility item in hand it no longer breaks weapon animations.
[*]Hand animation fixed when spawning without any items equipped.
[*]Fix for dino territory generation when not enough reference points.
[/list]

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts.

notes.content:
Greetings dinosaur hunters!

Thank you for the continued feedback and ideas! Your support helps us tremendously! ːsteamhappyː

And remember to check out the patch video!

[previewyoutube=AWBXD3OL59s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Reworked first person models and animations[/h1]

First person view has gotten a complete overhaul. All characters now have their own arm models and the model reflects the chosen clothing for your character. All first person animations have been redone. Many animations have a lot more detail than the old animations. 

New animations also mean that animations you’ve gotten used to have changed. Some loading animations might be shorter and some longer, take it into account! You will notice that after you change weapon all weapons are ready to use immediately without extra animations. You can no longer shoot while running.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/63df30f54dda43b4303b187d1721bd1d3083bbc8.png[/img]

[h1]Thalassodromeus: New flying reptile[/h1]

A new pterosaur species called Thalassodromeus is now dominating the skies with Pteranodon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/579305afc156bf9a74ad6a948dab82dd95cc8f32.png[/img]

[h1]Mosasaurus: The first aquatic reptile[/h1]

The first fully aquatic species Mosasaurus is now living in the water. Take care when finding loot boxes in the water! 

[b]Mosasaurus cannot yet be hunted as the current equipment cannot be used underwater. We’ll be implementing it in the coming updates![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/27c3a83ec39d7f6b8608daad7a4e9bed048a5766.png[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer network improvements[/h1]

We have done multiple improvements to multiplayer networking. This means that players and dinosaurs will be synced better for clients. Player vertical look sending lots of unnecessary messages was fixed.

We added a lot more debug information and improved sent message calculation.  We added new debug information and more accurate message calculation. We added dinosaur message per second calculation. Improved prediction accuracy.

Fixed issues with special dinosaur states that would be incorrectly synced to clients.

[h1]Iguanodon rework[/h1]

Iguanodon has been reworked with new model, textures and animations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8fd2b7aac18614123da9f451b1722274ad59b10d.png[/img]

[h1]New distance and ambience fog[/h1]

New distance fog was created to smooth out the look of the environment. New ambience fog was added which is most present in foggy weather. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/cec3bf7ee9efa76868b96a3828cc4d959ed6235d.png[/img]

[h1]Loot boxes improvement and water loot boxes[/h1]

Loot boxes can be found in the water too. They can be recognized from their orange/white skin. Water loot boxes have higher chances of having more valuable items in them and can include weapons. The land loot boxes were buffed to have a chance to include all other items except weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/cd05ea7b01d0ac3d15fd879b36f9b8330da1edea.png[/img]

[h1]Sell items in the shop[/h1]

You can now sell all the inventory items in the shop. You’ll get 50% from the buy price of the item. Find some loot boxes or sell your excess items to get credits for other purchases.

Please note that if you sell ammunition you need to have a minimum amount of that ammunition type to be able to sell it. The minimum is as many as there’s for one purchasable ammunition pack, for example pistol ammo pack has 40 rounds. The UI tells you the amount that’s sold at one go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/6f8b58495cf6a375de6839850ebbc8fac1f45a57.png[/img]

[h1]Hard mode[/h1]

You can now to choose to play in normal (Difficulty level which has existed before) or hard mode. Hard mode is aimed for experienced players who want more challenge. Hard mode has it’s own leaderboard that can be toggled in existing leaderboard menu. The following modifiers apply in hard mode:
[list]
[*]Non vital hits make less damage
[*]50% more experience and credits for kills and contracts
[*]Dinosaurs make double damage
[*]Map guides (orange circles) removed for non-tracking contracts. Tracking contracts will have a larger circle than in normal mode.
[/list]

[h1]Ragdoll improvements[/h1]

When dinosaur dies transition to ragdoll has been smoothed out. And the ragdolls will no longer stretch. Brachiosaurus, Ankylosaurus and T-Rex ragdolls were improved.

[h1]New clothing: Gloves[/h1]

You can purchase gloves that fit each of the clothing options. You can choose to go without gloves too! Your choices are reflected on the look of the first person character too.

[h1]New clothing: Boonie hat[/h1]

Boonie hats are now available for purchase in all camouflage options. They can be used by all characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/0ed043879bdaa5a914761f6a9ccecc7dd0ce67db.jpg[/img]

[h1]Revolver remake[/h1]

A fleshed-out revolver model has replaced the old revolver model. It has completely new animations too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/aa211cdb0452c0ccffb118501a1833ad2eb26e7b.png[/img]

[h1]50 cal heavy rifle remake[/h1]

50 cal has been remade with new model, animations and sounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/b8b1687105398a41c21818cb13ed1d6edd778d2e.png[/img]

[h1]New weapon: Heavy Rifle .338[/h1]

A new weapon has arrived! .338 heavy rifle is a bolt-action rifle. It costs 4000 credits so you can afford it before the other heavier rifles. You’ll need to buy .338 ammo for it. And you might notice the model looks very similar to the old 50 cal model …

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/5fa7b04883426e8a45a4ad3e002ce7221707287e.png[/img]

[h1]Tracking improvement[/h1]

Tracking system has been rewritten! This allows to display a lot more tracks on the ground. You’ll find dinosaurs leave tracks more often making tracking more viable.

We’ve fixed an error in tracking caused by other player respawning in multiplayer.

[h1]New sound effects[/h1]

Some new sound effects have been added for most of the weapons. Flashlight operation sound effect was changed. We will continue to improve the sound world in the coming updates.

[h1]New localization: Brazilian Portuguese[/h1]

Thanks to Joseph M the game is now available in Brazilian Portuguese.

[h1]Offline mode improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*]Missions are now loaded and saved to offline cache
[*]Storage items are now correctly loaded and saved to offline cache
[*]Player leveling integrated to offline with cached leveling properties
[*]Coin and xp reward notifications now implemented to offline
[*]Location data is now loaded from offline cache
[*]Trophies are now correctly loaded from offline cache
[/list]

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*]Updated French translation (Thanks MagSouille!)
[*]Inventory, storage etc. shows decimals for used capacity
[*]Improved rendering of long sun shadows when source of shadow is out of view
[*]In game menu settings now show correct values and slider positions when opening the menu.
[*]Improved tree culling, so there are less disappearing distant trees
[*]Optimized taxidermized trophies storage on server.
[*]Improved error reporting when loading a mod with syntax error
[*]Pachycephalosaurus walk animation was adjusted
[*]Ankylosaurus has new textures
[*]Inventory item menus can now be opened with both left and right mouse clicks
[*]New UI icons for clothes
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Taxed dinosaurs now check for unique ID, so no duplicates / missing taxidermizes happen.
[*]Contracts now check for unique ID, so no duplicates / missing completed contracts happen between sessions.
[*]Fix for player not getting starting items when switching between development, demo and production server
[*]Fix for getting stuck in creating a game server when having too short server name.
[*]Fixed rounding issue in item hover info where ammo capacity would have incorrect value displayed
[*]Fixed item duplication issue on client players due to server delay
[*]Mission where user needs to own an item can now be completed when the item is in the equipment slots
[/list]

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts. What would you like to see next?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/994ad07830f23aab73cf8efe199757b34ad5b2a5.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

Today’s update brings improvements to hitboxes and new accessories for characters. Read on to find out more.

Thanks again for our community! You helped us shape the content with your direct input. We are thankful for all the feedback! ːsteamhappyː 

[h1]High scores[/h1]

High score list displays 100 best scores instead of ten per dinosaur. Whenever player claims / taxes a dinosaur with a high score they get a notification with the position in the high score list. High score list view is updated immediately when player makes it to the list. Please note that the list will display only the highest score you have for a certain dinosaur. All dinosaurs have improved hitboxes. All dinosaurs walking with four legs now have hitbox location in front legs (hits register into Thigh_R or Thigh_L). New hitboxes were added to necks, tails, wings etc. so that they match the models better. Gaps found in hitboxes were fixed for many dinosaurs which should prevent shots not being registered that looked like direct hits. Some hitboxes were resized to better match the dinosaur physique.

notes.title: World Revamp Update is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/357a345ae26e392d333aa3b92058b6aed74a45a3.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

Today’s major update brings the long-waited graphics overhaul. 

Huge thanks to our great community! Your support is crucial and we are thankful for your feedback and ideas. The open testing phase for the update brought a lot of valuable information for us. Now you can enjoy the update in the actual server!

Check this video to get a glimpse what has been changed:

[previewyoutube=tb6onyEKnH8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Graphics overhaul[/h1]

Graphics overhaul changes the look of the game. We switched to a newer more advanced graphics engine. We have recreated all the shaders, lights, color space, materials, lods, reflections, global illumination, weather, water and culling systems. 

[h2]Water[/h2]
Water has been reworked. It now has waves and reflections from the environment. Players and dinosaurs create waves and foam when swimming and moving in water. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/4c4081b191ac50d7736ba9525afe0bb636169e50.png[/img]

[h2]Weather[/h2]
Weather manager was reworked. Weather transitions aren’t done in specific intervals like previously.

[h2]Vegetation overhaul[/h2]
All vegetation now moves with the wind.
Different types of bushes now sway from players and dinosaurs going through them. 

[h2]Trophy lodge[/h2]
Trophy lodge materials, lighting and reflections have been reworked. The performance of the lodge was also drastically improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/40b711059a994d8979d6bab86ad324dc06a2a024.png[/img]

[h2]Distant terrain[/h2]
Distant terrain has more detail.

[h1]New player characters[/h1]
The old characters are no more and there are three new player characters to choose from: Jack, Amy and Scotch. You can customize hair for these characters.

Following improvements were done to characters:
[list]
[*]Amy has own new sound effects.
[*]Improved character animations
[*]Improved character animation in menu
[*]Improved walking animation
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/d958c80f3229289bb2021385665176db4fe8711a.png[/img]

[h1]Clothing system[/h1]
Clothing can now be customized for your character. You’ll find these options by accessing “CHARACTER” in the main menu. Only one set of clothes is available by default, but you’ll be able to buy more outfits with credits. These items are now available:

Clothes:
[list]
[*]Old Preton Clothing
[*]Old Army Clothing
[*]Red Camouflage Clothing
[*]Tropical Hunting Clothing
[*]Tropical 3D Hunting Clothing
[/list]
* All clothing is available in short and long sleeved versions

Hats:
[list]
[*]Basic Cap
[*]Hunting Beanie
[*]Forest Cap
[*]Military Cap
[*]Cowboy Hat
[/list]

Glasses:
[list]
[*]Round Sunglasses
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/ecaf6bd2863192d3aa706188417225db23d5ce08.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/a507b726ddb6c8898749c6956cea846a2cb8c5f7.png[/img]

[h1]Main menu rework[/h1]
Main menu has new background. New characters are also shown within the new background environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/5896616e19f77628b5fcd87fa74663f99f4b65e5.png[/img]

[h1]New dinosaur models[/h1]
Several dinosaur models have been reworked. We will continue to upgrade models in the coming updates.

[h2]New Ankylosaurus[/h2]
Ankylosaurus has been reworked. It now has a new model, textures and animations. AI updates were also done and now Ankylosaurus eat from bushes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/6d93c2c8d07cedabf95b2a21bd483ffa5eb4b2d5.png[/img]

[h2]Model rework for Triceratops[/h2]
Triceratops model has been reworked and it has gotten new textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/f5b034fd8f8c1616d4822f6b56f1c0c934c8fe7c.png[/img]

[h2]Texture rework for Giganotosaurus[/h2]
Textures for Giganotosaurus were redone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/2370c9b83f3a5b35c62ec3832f7f8595d6b142dc.png[/img]

[h1]Wounded dinosaur visuals[/h1]
Dinosaurs that have gotten damage from other dinosaurs will now have blood on their skin. It is also displayed on dead dinosaurs killed by other dinosaurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/c74c3a522f4e7f182f7708ff008602bc7fc539b6.png[/img]

[h1]Range finder[/h1]
Range finder is now available from the shop. With it you’re able to measure distance to the point you’re looking at. It has variable zoom from 6x to 10x magnification giving it slightly bigger zoom than the regular binoculars. With left click you can also place a map marker to the point you’re looking at. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/28d480b2bd5f2027ef8631b1bfed405597f005c7.png[/img]

[*]Brachiosaurus now eat from trees. Eating sound effect was added

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/d6a56012022e2b41ef133627426995c525734bad.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Improved player data management to combat item losses when having message losses with backend
[*]Fixed issue with sleep in multiplayer
[*]Fixed errors in inventory
[*]Fixed errors while reloading
[*]Fixed errors in dinosaur spawner
[*]Fixed inventory issue caused by game state export (F3)
[*]Fix for player sometimes getting stuck in descent
[*]Fixed “x-ray vision” which allowed player to see dinos transparent behind terrain

[*]Fixed pistol left hand from being out of place sometimes when reloading
[/list]

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts. What would you like to see next?

notes.title: Open testing for upcoming major update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/b2aae60728a03be5d711eae11b331a711916c78b.png[/img]

[b]Greetings dinosaur hunters!
[/b]

Open testing of the upcoming major update is now available! If you want to help us locate any possible issues and give feedback before the release you can try out the test build. 

The included screenshots have been taken using the latest test build.

[h1]Things to take into account before starting testing[/h1]

The open testing version of the game utilizes different server. You won’t be using the same player in the test version but start from zero with a fresh player. Once you move back to the main server you will continue progress with your existing account and lose any progress made in the test server.

[b]Before you start transferring your game into the open testing mode please make a backup of your player.txt file. It can be found in %steamlibrary_folder%/Prehistoric Hunt/Prehistoric_Hunt_Data/player.txt . The file contains your trophy lodge setup and it will be overwritten if you don’t take a backup. Once you move back from the test version to the actual game you can copy this backup file back to it’s original location.[/b]

Please note that when you have the test build active you cannot launch the actual game. When you want to switch back to it in the Betas-menu you will need to choose ‘None’ to get back. You can freely switch between the versions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/ca1810b188f551e04b9398fe50956b7990502161.jpg[/img]

[h1]Instructions how to get the test version[/h1]

Right click the game name in Steam library list view and choose ‘Properties’. Then choose tab ‘Betas’. From the dropdown choose “public_test”. Steam will now download the test version and you’ll see in your library view instead of “Prehistoric Hunt” name “Prehistoric Hunt [public_test].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/2de84808ae4d20c03b479c3b9050419d03668ce1.png[/img]

[h1]New things to test[/h1]

As the next update will feature the graphics overhaul we’d like to get feedback how the new system runs on your setups. Overall feedback on the update is also welcome. We have still time to make alterations on content based on your feedback.

We’ve listed known issues / missing features in the open testing version in a list in Discord and will update the list based on your feedback.

What new stuff in addition to the graphics can you check? In short it’s here:
[list]
[*]New item: Rangefinder
[*]Death screen shows amount of dropped items if any
[*]New clothes and characters
[*]Bushes sway from player and dinosaur interaction
[*]Water has waves and player swims along waves sometimes going underwater
[*]Dinosaurs have blood marks if hurt by other dinosaurs
[*]The newest death marker is shown with bigger icon than older death markers in the map
[*]Login animation when starting game
[*]Fix for multiplayer sleep issue
[*]Taxidermized dinosaur which has high score appears in high score
[*]How trophy lodge runs
[*]New main menu background works
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/abea85dbcd0b28771cdad2d91aae385bb8cd9e23.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your support! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Development Blog #23 – A major update incoming with graphics overhaul etc!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8507373ca48c504edb31d32a8ebb6ae7205680a9.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

We are working on a major update that will bring multiple requested improvements to the game. It will include biggest graphics improvement yet, new player characters, clothing system and a range finder. Find out more in this blog!

Here is a video showcasing what has already been done:

[previewyoutube=gB0Bds2XSoI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Graphics overhaul[/h1]

The game is being changed to HDRP graphics pipeline. It means that all game materials, lights and shaders need to be reworked to take advance of this technology. When the whole process is ready it will make the game look better. 

Water has already been reworked. Water has waves and reflections. 

Trophy lodge materials have also been reworked. The performance of lodge was also drastically improved.

Distant terrain has more detail.

Bushes that the player runs through will sway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/cf614bd852e0b93b680812b528b9738eb140bc26.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/f7e562331956b5cc00d1471057e088c1912463d6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/e8a9ac6746e7026f6e15a31cd44b5139a4111df3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/3aa2f988217b3e598fddf1bf25259a0eab56cd5c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New player characters[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/87b30eb999a651fb7b497bf6467dce67b26105d9.png[/img]

New players characters will replace the old characters after the next update. There will be a young male, female, and an older male character to choose from. 

[h1]Hunting clothing[/h1]

We are working on different hunting clothing you will be able to purchase. The idea is the better clothing will make less sound and make you more camouflaged.

[h1]Range finder[/h1]

Range finder will offer more functionality than the existing binoculars. With it you’ll see the distance to the point you’re looking at in meters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/a492ac1b4a1bf6f602477347ff369dd1ffcdfe74.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/a480730cac0bdb2688e08c0573be206f64eb8dc5.png[/img]

[h1]Visual rework for Ankylosaurus[/h1]

New model has been built for Ankylosaurus and is now being animated. AI and behavior will also be improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/9ade7e6d30c059f4329988a047b13fa9013a94b5.png[/img]

[h1]Wounded dinosaur visuals[/h1]

Dinosaurs that have been gotten damage from other dinosaurs will show blood on their skin making it easier to identify wounded dinosaurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8deb1b064b1a3519f39af6b0243d3e1e6701d44c.png[/img]

These improvements you can expect to see in the next update :)

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts.

notes.title: Trophy Shot Update has landed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/357a345ae26e392d333aa3b92058b6aed74a45a3.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

A new year begins with a new update! Today’s update brings trophy shots and piebald dinosaur skin type to the game. Read through the full patch notes to find all content.

Happy New Year to everyone! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Trophy shots[/h1]

Want a photo with your catch? Now you can do it with the new trophy shot feature. Trophy shots can be initiated in the trophy menu by clicking “Trophy shot”. 

HUD will guide you to all controls available. You can freely move the camera and then with right click toggle to moving the dinosaur. You can then drag different body parts and freeze them into positions you like. You can also move your player character in similar way. You can have different equipment in hand, just equip it before going to the trophy shot menu.

You can take as many trophy shots with your prey as you like. Trophy shots are stored as Steam screenshots making sharing them in Steam easy. You can also find them on your hard drive by right clicking the screenshot in Steam and choosing “Browse to screenshot” or by browsing to %game_install_directory%\Prehistoric_Hunt_Data\screenshots .

Trophy shots work in multiplayer too, you can have your friends in the photos. The corpse movement is not synced to other players when moving the ragdoll.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/d45ffc12a6161871dbb069750bf76a8f3991fdc7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8457708710ab4c2d238ed8ab243d83f84165dd52.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/5267c64c1a544ed9a074524098b2c45d26826300.png[/img]

[h1]New skin type: Piebald[/h1]

All dinosaurs have a new skin variation called piebald. Piebald dinosaurs can be recognized from their spotty skin which looks like it’s missing color in some parts. It is a very rare skin type to encounter.

Now all skin types in order of rarity are:
[list]
[*]Common
[*]Rare
[*]Piebald
[*]Melanistic
[*]Albino
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/7266784055543e173dc1edfc235e0f705671b1fd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/686a91e1ae0879950f33ceb69f8a82b0ebc548e9.png[/img]

[h1]Dinosaur ragdolls improvements[/h1]

Many different improvements were made to dinosaur ragdolls to make them work better in trophy shots. Ragdolls clip less inside terrain keeping most parts above terrain. Carnivores jaws move and can be adjusted in trophy shots. Limbs in general move better.

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*]Inventory and shop now show item weights per item/stack
[*]Grass render distance can now be adjusted
[*]Pteranodon photo was updated
[*]Swimming hands are no longer affected by view model adjustments
[*]Finetuned ground textures
[*]Adjusted post processing settings to make image sharper and brighter
[*]Updated French translation (Thanks MagSouille!)
[*]Minor improvements to dinosaur synchronization in multiplayer
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed an equipment duplication issue
[*]Fixed cases where switching from flare when lighting it could cause other item to be lost when flare expires
[*]Also fixed case where trying to lit flare, but fails and switching to other item at the same time could get hands stuck in flare animation
[*]Fixed issue where mismatching equipment data between client and server could cause issues and equipment changes
[*]Fixed an issue when player went swimming with bow drawn causing a ghost arrow
[*]Fixed an issue with player name sending
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts. What would you like to see next?

notes.title: The Second Anniversary Update has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/454f4a360b85113451561ee5f80ae3096e595755.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

The game launched in Early Access two years ago and what better way to celebrate this than with a fresh update! We enjoy developing the game and are grateful to our [b]great community[/b] for your support and feedback! Let’s keep going!

The key things in this update are tents and flares. Read through the patch notes to find what else is included!

Also: Join our Discord here if you already haven't!

[url=https://discord.gg/sKEMnbF55T ]https://discord.gg/sKEMnbF55T [/url]

[h1]Tents: Skip the night[/h1]

In tents players can skip the night. Tent have been placed in fixed locations including the existing special locations and the new locations included in the update. Some of the special locations don’t have a tent and instead you can find a bed where to sleep. Tents can be used during nighttime to change the time to morning. Usage is free of charge.

Tents work in multiplayer too: All players will need to express will to skip the night. When the first player accesses a tent other players will get a notification that a player wants to sleep. When all players are within tents the nighttime is skipped. The waiting players see a status screen indicating how many players are still being waited for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/408b504fc94d1570447be48924762ab50f4271a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/07997c5268202f74bb3cdb38d18dd6f949717f7b.png[/img]

[h1]New locations[/h1]

New discoverable locations have been added. There are now two types of locations: orange and blue. Orange locations are the old special locations with multiple vendors. Blue locations are the new locations. There are three types of locations with different capabilities:

[list]
[*]Pick up point
[*]Stash
[*]Resting spot
[/list]

[h2]Pick up points[/h2]

Pick up points act as one-way fast travel service. You’re able to fast travel from them to any special location (Orange points on the map).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/b759d11e8800e67e2293949fadbf21cfaa7a4568.png[/img]

[h2]Stashes[/h2]

Stashes include the global storage box. Here you can access your global storage items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/9796cf4eb66c47c0865ae466504658fa06854251.png[/img]

[h2]Resting spots[/h2]

Resting spots have a tent. You can spend the night there and continue your hunting journey in the morning. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/39a105f4eaa54c770a7f60bc949c2426ff538b50.png[/img]

[h1]Flares[/h1]
Flares are now available! They are one use items which will scare some of the dinosaurs and distract others. They can be used to help you avoid some encounters.

Flares can be bought from the shop with cost of 15 credits. You’ll need to equip it in one of the utility equipment slots (slots 4-6). HUD will provide guidance to flare usage. First you take the cap of. Then you will attempt to light it. There is a chance the flare won’t ignite on every try.

Once lit, a flare can be held in hand, dropped, or thrown. Flares will burn for one minute. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/e4f8bbf0e927425c13cc9051f34d687b7a46ccc7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/3a857e13778501ab0b7e75d792ba0de94cd3d8fa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/1f032fd004368765299c9cb034188da52496e367.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/a11bf2f1584a8e7de164f192ca8cc3ab69513c55.png[/img]

[h1]New dinosaur model for Pteranodon[/h1]

Pteranodon model got a visual rework.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/f0418d32d1d47937f94629cf6a9a708ead805f38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/f17858b6a9edfedeb073bbd95732f13ff41c756d.png[/img]

[h1]View model adjustment[/h1]

It’s now possible to adjust the view model which affects how player’s hands and weapon look on screen. Players can find the menu in game by going to options and clicking “Adjust view model”. You can adjust horizontal, vertical and depth offset. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8d074c56d095eef35cec972b13d7d2ba44688189.png[/img] 

[h1]Region change UI[/h1]

Region change is now easier in the main menu and you can now see your ping to each region. Once you’ve selected Play game you can see option in bottom right to switch region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/ed347b90adb7c06397f47cc924cf2b8c1d99032a.png[/img]

[h1]Controller support improvements[/h1]

Multiple improvements were done to make more of the game controls working with a controller.

[list]
[*]A radial menu was introduced for use with controllers, default key bind D-pad up. With it players can select quickly all equipped items from slots 1-6.
[*]Auto walk is now possible, default key bind left stick click
[*]Flashlight default key bind was moved to right stick click
[*]Changing scope zoom level is now possible, default key bind D-pad up / down
[*]Inventory now works fully with controller.
[*]Feedback menu now is fully usable with controller.
[*]Added sounds when navigating menus with controller.
[*]Improved navigation in scrolling lists when using controller.
[*]Fixed minor issues in menus when using controller.
[*]Improved bow shooting with controller.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/2349884c23e8b9db2fe1dfef51a4a6ec5587b8c9.png[/img]

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*]Updated French translation (Thanks MagSouille!)
[*]A crouch-icon is displayed in the HUD when player is crouching
[*]UI was improved
[*]Game engine has been updated
[*]Bleeding amount increased from vital organ hits
[*]Added sounds to UI buttons and elements that were missing sounds
[*]Graphics settings are automatically adjusted from hardware settings
[*]A notification is given on successful taxidermizing
[*]Player’s currency is shown when trophy details screen is used
[*]Game state export is now possible with F3 if you are stuck or some other game problems occur. You can send the game state export to developers with your bug report to help us analyze and hunt down the problem.
[*]Improved equipment handling when server and local data does not match
[*]Changed couple of tree textures for more variance
[*]Optimized multiplayer event sending 
[*]Added missing translations
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Spinosaurus could clip inside terrain
[*]Fixed issue where player didn’t respawn with full health
[*]Added missing death location notification text
[*]Storage and inventory weapon filter was fixed
[/list]

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts. What would you like to see next?

notes.title: The Modular Trophy Lodge Update has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/f8e2e4814f15f399264e81aac56f233fd86c0295.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

The modular trophy lodges are here! With the new system you are able to build a bigger and more customizable lodge. You can add new rooms of different types, trophy head wall mounts and various decoration items freely. Read through the patch notes to find what else is included! 

Also: Join our Discord here if you already haven't! 

[url=https://discord.gg/sKEMnbF55T ]Prehistoric Hunt Discord[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/ec26af0ceb8a20acbdb543ddbb3cd8e0d5c0acaa.png[/img]

[h1]New trophy lodge rooms 
[/h1]

Players can now add new rooms into their trophy lodges. Your default room is the hall as previously. Now you will spot doors on walls that are highlighted with orange color in the editing mode. When you interact with the doors you can expand the lodge into new rooms. 

 There are three types of rooms to choose from: 
[list]
[*] Hall (the old default room in game), grid size 2x1, cost to unlock: 200, level required: 1 
[*] Room, grid size 1x1, cost to unlock: 200, level required: 3 
[*] Room with fireplace, grid size 1x1, cost to unlock: 400, level required: 5 
[/list]

New room types can be unlocked with credits. Once you’ve unlocked the type you can add as many as you want. 

There's a limit to how many rooms you can add to the lodge. Each new room takes up space from your room grid. Starting from your default hall you can expand it with 2 grid slots in each direction making total amount of slots 30 (5x6).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/fb00e20043f9b1911ccf77b18d9da704fad646b1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/dbb20e771a9a257b2c79db6440eb91f01b66d984.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/91cdc4cc2b3cfc9e96eb0f03d2abcfa149e7e89c.png[/img]

[h1]New stand types 
[/h1]

There are now five types of stands to display trophies: 
[list]
[*] Stand, Rectangle 
[*] Stand, Round 
[*] Stand, Wall 
[*] Stand, Wall Small 
[*] Stand, Rectangle with low profile 
[/list]

[h2]Trophy head wall mounts 
[/h2]

With wall mounts players are able to display dinosaur heads on walls. There are two sizes of wall mounts: one for bigger and one for smaller dinosaurs. When adding dinosaur head for display the list will show compatible dinosaurs only in the list. Currently all dinosaurs can be placed on the wall stands except for Compsognathus, Gallimimus and Iguanodon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/bd37be62bd5a2e10af1904be3ca915339a1ee84b.png[/img]

[h2]Floor stands 
[/h2]

In addition to rectangle stands new round stands were added. There’s also a new rectangle stand with lower profile. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/361c583d2febba489a721a7edb90c6baa8573e18.png[/img]

[h1]Decoration items 
[/h1]

New decoration items can be added to your lodge from the I menu. Most of the items need to be unlocked with player levels and credits but some of them are already open on the first level. Once you’ve unlocked an item you can place as many as you like. You can freely rotate and place the items. You can also remove these items one by one in the edit mode with E key. 

Here is list of items you can add: 
[list]
[*] Chair, Leather cushion 
[*] Chair, Turquoise cushion 
[*] Table, Small 
[*] Table, Small type 2 
[*] Table, Small round 
[*] Table, Large 
[*] Bed 
[*] Bookshelf, Large empty 
[*] Bookshelf, Small empty 
[*] Bookshelf, Large with some books 
[*] Couch, Patterned cushion 
[*] Couch, Brown cushion 
[*] Couch, Green cushion 
[*] Stool, Turquoise cushion 
[*] Cupboard, Tall with glass door 
[*] Cupboard, Low with drawers 
[*] Coat hanger 
[*] Mirror 
[*] Shelf, Empty 
[*] Shelf, With drawers 
[*] Carpet, Large, Black and white 
[*] Carpet, Large, Red 
[*] Carpet, Small Square 
[*] Carpet, Small Round 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/48404e8374cff34e4d6f493816a0e9e93643b83e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/94cb9a0d0eb37762164a508a5a9ca57185a98032.png[/img]

[h1]Guidance to lodge usage 
[/h1]

We’ve added a HUD to trophy lodge that players can show and hide with U key. The HUD is there to guide players to the controls with which you can add items and rotate them. 

Floor stands will also display in which direction the dinosaur will be facing making placing them easier. This is shown with orange arrow on top of the stand when placing it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/e9b1403432ba0493cb1b2218af41e9e607ec1b86.png[/img]

[h1]Resetting your lodge 
[/h1]

If you want to start over you can reset your lodge. This enables you to arrange rooms in different way. You won’t lose any unlocks or trophies if you reset the lodge, all of them can be placed again. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/6b8998debb3af0d45b53b3403c5c96c6f8a0cb8a.png[/img]

[h1]New dinosaur model for Carnotaurus 
[/h1]

Carnotaurus model got a visual rework. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/fbc4ddf909ed8733287a4cb8f9c7f666983c0d6b.png[/img]

[h1]Other improvements 
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Updated French translation (Thanks MagSouille!) 
[*] UI grid can now expand when increasing capacity of global stash 
[*] New footstep sounds to trophy lodge
[*] Trophy lodge lightning and reflections have been enhanced. Trophy lodge now uses screen space reflections and cube maps. 
[*] Improved tranquilizer rifle iron sights aiming 
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes 
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed controller issue in main menu where players weren’t able to select menu items 
[*] Inventory bug fixes 
[*] Minor bug fixes 
[/list]

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts.

notes.title: Development Blog #21 - Trophy lodge customization
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8507373ca48c504edb31d32a8ebb6ae7205680a9.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

We are currently working on several improvements to trophy lodges. There will be a way to add new rooms and customize the content of these rooms in various ways. All images are work in progress images and are subject to change.

[h2]New rooms to lodge
[/h2]
We are developing a more advanced system where players will be able to add more rooms into their trophy lodges. Currently we have implemented three types of rooms: 

[list]
[*] Hall (the current room in game)
[*] Room

notes.title: Spinosaurus Update is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/f8e2e4814f15f399264e81aac56f233fd86c0295.png[/img]

Greetings dinosaur hunters!

Spinosaurus Update brings multiple improvements to the game including Spinosaurus and interchangeable rifle scopes. [b]It’s again recommended to check these patch notes before playing![/b]

Thanks again for your feedback and ideas! ːsteamhappyː Many items in this update are a result of your direct feedback. Join our Discord here if you already haven't:

[url=https://discord.gg/sKEMnbF55T ]Prehistoric Hunt Discord[/url]

[h1]New dinosaur: Spinosaurus
[/h1]

The island's first semiaquatic dinosaur Spinosaurus is here. It’s a large carnivore that can move both in land and water. It is a very fast swimmer so beware of it while in the water!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/89ac6bed30b10a60bf77e6b8e6eb50bd9d55b362.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/6175d636cfa1e2958e930e9ab6678198e26981fb.png[/img]

[h1]Interchangeable rifle scopes
[/h1]

Rifles no longer have built in scopes. Instead their default sights are now iron sights and you can attach a scope of your liking to the weapon. There are multiple scopes to choose from. 

[b]Please note that your existing rifles don’t have any scopes on them now by default. You need to travel to the nearest special location to buy one.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/262cf2cb7c7fbd2390292b76773068cbcaa6ba4f.png[/img]

In the shop you can now find a new item category called “Sights” where you’ll find all purchasable scopes. Currently the selection is following:

[list]
[*] Standard 2x20 Rifle Scope. A standard fixed zoom scope. This was previously the built-in scope of rifles.
[*] Standard 4x20 Rifle Scope. A standard fixed zoom scope.
[*] 2-4x24 Rifle Scope. An adjustable scope for shorter distances.
[*] 4-8x32 Rifle Scope. An adjustable scope for longer distances.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/4d7e018db9b0c48515df592e8f5373b107217968.png[/img]

These scopes are usable with these weapons:
[list]
[*] Basic rifle
[*] Hunting rifle
[*] 50 cal rifle
[/list]

In your inventory you’ll now find an attachment slot next to your equipped weapons. This is where you can drag & drop a scope.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/4bc89a07c83e948882f2db64ecfbd98f1f0d2e65.png[/img]

The basic rifle model was updated to include iron sights and a rail to mount scopes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/0558a473bb1edc2c29a843fcaf4f9a5ff432176f.png[/img]

The hunting rifle model was updated to include iron sights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8de8e1073d1d2ebb979ad069e0b4d9538b4faf20.png[/img]

Some of the scopes have adjustable zoom. The zoom level can be adjusted with mouse scroll when scoped in. When not scoped in, the mouse scroll will change to the next weapon like it has worked previously.

[h1]AI improvements: Drinking dinosaurs & other
[/h1]

Dinosaurs have new behavior: They now need to have a drink regularly. This gives hunters a new way to find dinosaurs by looking for water sources the dinosaurs use. The behavior currently affects Brachiosaurus, Ankylosaurus, Triceratops, Gallimimus, Pachycephalosaurus and Iguanodon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/eac7408649da7b6ba0aff1a386880f982d66025f.png[/img]

Dinosaur detection logic was updated. New behavior was added to dinosaurs to take into account swimming players.

[h1]Swimming[/h1]

Players are now able to access water areas with swimming. Players are only able to access inventory and flashlight while swimming, no items can be held in hand. Auto movement can be used and using shift makes the character swim faster. Players aren’t able to dive yet.

When a player dies while swimming their dropped inventory can be found on death location on the surface.

All dinosaurs that fall in water can now be claimed. Their bodies will stay near the surface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/d2e52ec8fad98f1825c4cae8693ab2759b96f63f.png[/img]

[h1]Ground texture improvements
[/h1]

[list]
[*] All ground has now a bit more detail
[*] Rock texture was renewed
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/8a8913acccbb281403c5ed002ec3005bbee10fb9.png[/img]

[h1]Modding improvements
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Custom Map Support
[*] Terrain Editor
[*] Custom Mesh and Material Support
[*] Custom Sound Support
[*] New mod parameters
[*] Improved error reporting in mod config files to help find issues in them
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/152799b5f2acee65f101521556c082c7d5390c8b.png[/img]

[h1]New translations
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added French translation (Thanks MagSouille)
[/list]
If you want to help translate Prehistoric Hunt to new languages, you can join our #community-translations channel in [url=https://discord.gg/sKEMnbF55T ]Prehistoric Hunt Discord[/url]. There you’ll find the game dictionary and get help with the work. We are really thankful for your support! :)

[h1]New dinosaur models
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Giganotosaurus got a visual rework: New model
[*] Pachycephalosaurus got a visual rework: New model and new textures.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926273/529a73b989c8e5ff06c9db016e0c6b9ac4902a8c.png[/img]

[h1]Other improvements
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Daytime is now longer
[*] Player no longer makes slow slides on hills. When the hill is steep enough, the player will start a bigger slide.
[*] Dinosaur turn animations are now more realistic. It takes more time for them to pivot to different directions.
[*] Loot box texture was improved
[*] Shotgun and revolver reload can be canceled after each separate shot is reloaded. To cancel, hit R or left mouse button. 
[*] Adjusted Brachiosaurus and Gallimimus size to be more realistic
[*] Player view is now slightly higher from ground
[*] Secondary inputs can now be disabled in the menus. This is a possible fix for reports of character moving on it’s own.
[*] Improved cone tree detail
[*] Start inventory now contains separate basic rifle scope
[*] Weapon positions are saved between sessions
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where dino names were invisible in leaderboard menu
[*] Fixed localization issues
[*] Fixed note menu scaling
[*] Possible fix to menu switching
[*] Fix for Steam authentication failing sometimes
[*] Player can now holster all equipment
[*] Fixed inventory issues when at full capacity and trying use and unequip items
[*] Fixed issue with inventory showing zero bullets after death
[*] Fixed shotgun shot multiply issue in multiplayer
[*] Fixed player typing in chat opening inventory when i-key is pressed
[/list]

Thank you for reading and we look forward to hearing your thoughts.
